product.name: TROTTEN desk (crank)
product.introText: TROTTEN desk sit/stand with crank, white, 160x80 cm (72-122 cm). Underframe instructions AA-2260717-3, table top AA-2179340-4. Two people needed to turn it over.
product.partsSummary: 2x Beam,  4x Bscrew,  1x Crank,  1x Crank holder,  1x Drive shaft,  4x Fbolt,  2x Foot,  4x Glide,  2x Hscrew,  2x Leg,  4x Lscrew,  1x Top,  8x Tscrew

steps.title: Table top and crank holder
steps.text: Lay the table top face down on a soft surface. Screw the crank holder under the front right corner.

steps.title: Legs
steps.text: Put both telescopic legs upside down on the table top, arms lying flat on the top.

steps.title: Cross beam
steps.text: Lay the two halves of the cross beam between the leg gearboxes, the narrow half sliding into the wide one.

steps.title: Beam screws
steps.text: Join the beam halves with 4 screws and fix the beam to both gearboxes with 4 screws, using the Allen key.

steps.title: Fix the legs to the top
steps.text: Screw both leg arms to the table top, 4 screws each.

steps.title: Drive shaft
steps.text: Push the hexagonal drive shaft through the beam into both gearboxes until it clicks.

steps.title: Feet
steps.text: Put the feet on the legs and fix each with 2 bolts.

steps.title: Glides
steps.text: Screw the 4 adjustable glides into the feet.

steps.title: Turn over and store the crank
steps.text: Two people: turn the desk over. Clip the crank into its holder; pull it out and turn it to raise or lower the desk (72-122 cm, max 50 kg).
